title: ContactOps two-axis triage scoring input
description: Trusted adapter DTO for synthetic operational triage. It combines field observations, canonical contact history, and public dong-level context. It is not the raw voice JSON and does not estimate a person's risk probability.
$comment: Evidence basis: Ministry of Health and Welfare neighbor-connector manual p11 (discovery characteristics), p14 and p48 (six warning signs), and p49 (home-visit observation fields). Weights are the separately versioned operational scoring contract, not claims made by the manual.

식사상태.$comment: Manual p49 meal-state field. Unknown or unmentioned is null.

위생상태.$comment: Manual p49 personal-hygiene field. Unknown or unmentioned is null.

공과금_2개월_이상_체납.$comment: Legacy-compatible internal key. The current product meaning is any utility arrears observed or reported, without a minimum duration. Do not populate from private utility-company anomaly feeds.

최근_건강_정신_괴로움.$comment: Manual p49 recent physical or mental difficulty observation. This is not a diagnosis.

관계망_유무.$comment: Manual p49 asks whether a person or institution is available for help.

연락_빈도.$comment: Social-contact frequency from manual p11 and p49 context. It is not ContactOps contact_cadence_days.

연속_미응답_횟수.$comment: Trusted projection of canonical contact.consecutive_no_answer_count. Voice output must not write this field.

개인_평소_응답률.$comment: Server-owned historical baseline in the closed interval 0..1. Not inferred by an LLM.

평소_응답률_대비_급락.$comment: Deterministic upstream history analysis supplies this predicate. Null means insufficient history.

마지막_연결_후_경과일.$comment: Derived from a successful last-connected date at 기준일. A failed contact attempt does not reset it.

재연락_기한.$comment: Korean projection of canonical workflow.follow_up_deadline, not contact.next_contact_date.

방문_승인_상태.$comment: Read-only projection of canonical workflow.visit_approval_status. Only an explicit manager action may create 승인 or 반려.

연락_두절.$comment: Manual p14 and p48 independent field observation. Do not set it from the same failed call that increments 연속_미응답_횟수.

관찰_6징후.$comment: The exact six warning signs in manual p14 and repeated observation checklist p48. Null means unobserved, not false.

동단위_구조취약도.$comment: Public dong-level context based on manual p11 discovery characteristics. The 0..50 normalization/version is supplied upstream; this schema does not invent weights. 162 current dongs remain mapped onto 156 dated geometry zones.
